title: Flux: Finding the Sweet Spot for Image Generation #shorts
description: Discover the critical 'strength' parameter in Flux. Below 50, it yields random images. At 100%, it causes artifacts. The sweet spot? Around 80% for creative freedom without chaos. #FluxControl #AIPainting #ArtParameters #DigitalArt

top_comments.author: @adamhagos5078
top_comments.text: the artifact vs mush tradeoff at the extremes is so real, spent way too long hovering around that middle range trying to land it. i ended up on mage space using one of their curated models for stuff like this and it landed in that sweet spot way more consistently without me babysitting the slider.
